metadata.description: Ideonomy skills for AI agents — systematic idea expansion using Patrick Gunkel's framework, synthesized by Grace Kind

plugins.name: ideonomy
plugins.description: Two complementary idea-expansion skills based on Patrick Gunkel's ideonomy — the science of treating ideas as natural phenomena that can be sliced, negated, recombined, and re-instantiated. ideonomy-plain outputs plain-text-portable artifacts (survives SMS/Telegram/Slack). ideonomy-rich outputs performative ASCII art for monospace terminals.
